name: OREGON ELECTRONICS
old_description: Welcome to Oregon Electronics - Your local source for electronics parts
about:
Oregon Electronics operates from Eugene, Oregon, where it was founded in 2011. The company remains privately held, though its ownership structure has not been publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business functions as a broad-line distributor of electronic components, carrying more than 100,000 unique part numbers that range from passive components and connectors to development boards, robotics kits, and 3D printers. It is an authorized distributor for FlashForge USA, selling the manufacturer’s desktop 3D printers such as the Dreamer dual-extrusion model. In addition to stocked inventory, Oregon Electronics offers custom cable assembly built to customer specifications, drawing on what it describes as over 25 years of combined staff experience in cable fabrication. A brick-and-mortar store in Eugene provides walk-in access during weekday and Saturday hours.

The customer base spans educational institutions, architectural firms, engineering consultancies, design studios, and the wider consumer and prosumer market that FlashForge targets. The company also supplies robotics hobbyists and makers through its robotics parts category.

Oregon Electronics emphasizes its deep inventory, the ability to special-order items not in stock, and its custom cable service as key differentiators. The firm highlights its experienced staff and local presence as reasons customers choose it for both off-the-shelf components and tailored cable solutions.
